title: Assistant Consultant - 3D Designer
description:
Work Experience :0\-1
  
##### **Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Create basic 3D models (props, simple characters, environment pieces) under guidance
* Assist with texturing and UV unwrapping
* Support basic VFX work (particle effects, simple shaders) using Blender
* Learn and apply rigging and animation basics for simple objects/characters
* Use AI\-assisted tools (texture generation, retopology helpers, etc.) to speed up work, while also building manual skills
* Help prepare and export assets for use in Unreal Engine (and Unity, if applicable)
* Take feedback from senior artists/developers and iterate on assets
* Handle day\-to\-day small asset requests to keep the game dev pipeline moving

  
**Experience\- 0 \- 1 Year**

##### **Skills Required:**

* Working knowledge of Blender (modeling, texturing, UV unwrapping)
* Basic understanding of how 3D assets are used in game engines
* Willingness to learn VFX and animation on the job
* Comfortable experimenting with AI tools for 3D/art workflows, while still building strong manual fundamentals
* A portfolio or personal projects showing Blender work (college projects, personal renders, freelance samples all count)

**Good to Have**

* Any exposure to Unreal Engine (import/export, basic material setup)
* Unity familiarity (optional, not mandatory)
* Any exposure to AI tools in art pipelines (texture gen, AI rigging/animation assist tools)
* Basic understanding of PBR texturing concepts

  
**Skills\- 3D Blender, Blender, 3D Designer, Animation, Modeling, Texturing, UV Unwrapping, VFX, Motion Graphc, AI Rigging, Unreal Engine, Maya, Autodesk, 3D Max, After Effects, Adobe Creaive Suites, AutoCAD, Photoshop**

**Experince\- 0 \- 1 Year**
